lines.zh: 靛蓝石缝里，我一寸一寸往前挪。
lines.en: In the indigo stone cracks, I inch forward.

lines.zh: 叶子擦过我的背，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Leaves brush my back, and I give a little shake.

lines.zh: 小短腿踩得碎石咔咔响。
lines.en: My short legs crunch the gravel with every step.

lines.zh: 果香在左边，我拐过去了。
lines.en: Fruit smell to the left; I turn that way.

lines.zh: 我拖着一段根须，慢慢爬。
lines.en: I drag a piece of root and crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 树根底下好像滚过一颗蹦蹦。
lines.en: Something bouncy rolled under the tree roots.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，怕踩碎掉落的果子。
lines.en: I step softly so I don't crush fallen fruit.

lines.zh: 这片林子是我的饭厅。
lines.en: This whole grove is my dining room.

lines.zh: 我绕开大石头，去找更软的地。
lines.en: I go around the big rock for softer ground.

lines.zh: 泥土松软，我一步陷半个脚。
lines.en: The soil is soft; every step sinks halfway.

lines.zh: 有甜味，我加快了一点点。
lines.en: Something smells sweet, so I hurry a little.

lines.zh: 我贴着靛蓝石走，那里最凉。
lines.en: I walk by the indigo stone, the coolest path.

lines.zh: 我坐着嚼一颗没吃完的果子。
lines.en: I sit and chew an unfinished piece of fruit.

lines.zh: 肚子鼓起来，我就想挖洞。
lines.en: When my belly swells, I want to dig.

lines.zh: 咕叽……我打了个小嗝。
lines.en: Gurp... I let out a tiny burp.

lines.zh: 我在石头下面刨出一个浅坑。
lines.en: I scrape a shallow hole beneath the stone.

lines.zh: 今天的蹦蹦好像特别少。
lines.en: The bouncies seem scarce today.

lines.zh: 我用爪子梳了梳背上的叶子。
lines.en: I comb the leaves on my back with my claws.

lines.zh: 风里有熟过头的果香。
lines.en: The wind smells of overripe fruit.

lines.zh: 我盯着影子里那片小叶子。
lines.en: I stare at the little leaf inside my shadow.

lines.zh: 我把挖出的碎石推到一边。
lines.en: I push the dug-up gravel off to one side.

lines.zh: 这根根须有点老，嚼不动。
lines.en: This root is old and too tough to chew.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻脚下的土，很湿。
lines.en: I sniff the soil under me; it is damp.

lines.zh: 我在等下一颗果子掉下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the next fruit to fall.

lines.zh: 阳光太亮，我缩进阴影里。
lines.en: The sun is bright, so I shrink into shade.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的脚印，数不清。
lines.en: I try counting my footprints and lose track.

lines.zh: 我把一颗蹦蹦按在爪下，慢慢吃。
lines.en: I pin a bouncy under my paw and nibble slowly.

lines.zh: 我刨着靛蓝石，指甲有点疼。
lines.en: I dig at the indigo stone until my claws ache.

lines.zh: 我闻见土里有甜的根须。
lines.en: I smell sweet roots in the soil.

lines.zh: 我趴着，听林子里果子落地。
lines.en: I lie still, listening for fruit falling.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，是蹦蹦吗？
lines.en: Is that thing in your hand a bouncy?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛圆圆的。
lines.en: I look up at you with round little eyes.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就往前挪一步。
lines.en: You crouch down, so I shuffle one step closer.

lines.zh: 你有吃的吗？我不挑的。
lines.en: Do you have food? I am not picky.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，盯着你的手。
lines.en: I tilt my head and stare at your hands.

lines.zh: 你别走，我还想再要一颗。
lines.en: Don't leave yet; I want another one.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道像树皮。
lines.en: You smell a little like tree bark.

lines.zh: 我盯了你半天，才慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at you forever, then blink slowly.

lines.zh: 你会喂我吗，像喂别人那样？
lines.en: Will you feed me like you feed the others?

lines.zh: 我伸出小爪子，够不到你。
lines.en: I stretch my small claws but can't reach you.

lines.zh: 你鞋边有颗果子，我看见了。
lines.en: There's a fruit by your boot; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我认住你的脸了，喂食的人。
lines.en: I know your face now, the one who feeds.

lines.zh: 疼！我的叶子掉了一片。
lines.en: Ouch! I lost one of my leaves.

lines.zh: 我缩进土里，只露半个头。
lines.en: I sink into the soil with half my head out.

lines.zh: 我吱了一声，跑了两步。
lines.en: I squeak and run two steps away.

lines.zh: 我只有一只果子那么大。
lines.en: I'm no bigger than a single piece of fruit.

lines.zh: 我背上的伤口在渗汁。
lines.en: Sap is seeping from the wound on my back.

lines.zh: 我趔趄着，果子也掉了。
lines.en: I stumble and drop the fruit I had.

lines.zh: 我蜷起来，把自己埋住。
lines.en: I curl up and bury myself in the dirt.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天缓不过来。
lines.en: That hit leaves me stunned for a long while.

lines.zh: 我抖得厉害，叶子全响了。
lines.en: I shake so hard all my leaves rattle.

lines.zh: 我躲到石头后面，偷偷看你。
lines.en: I hide behind a stone and peek at you.

lines.zh: 蹦蹦！我什么都听不见了。
lines.en: A bouncy! I can't hear anything else.

lines.zh: 给我一颗，我立刻跟你走。
lines.en: Give me one and I'll follow you right away.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，爪子往前扑。
lines.en: I jump up and throw my claws forward.

lines.zh: 那果子的味道，隔着土都闻到。
lines.en: I smell that fruit even through the soil.

lines.zh: 我只要蹦蹦，别的都不要。
lines.en: I only want bouncies, nothing else at all.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我的头就跟着晃。
lines.en: When you wiggle it, my head wiggles too.

lines.zh: 再近一点，就一点点。
lines.en: Just a little closer, only a tiny bit.

lines.zh: 我喉头一动，咕噜响了一声。
lines.en: My throat bobs with a loud little gulp.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖蹭你手里的果子。
lines.en: I rub my nose against the fruit you hold.

lines.zh: 这一颗够我挖半天的洞了。
lines.en: This one is worth half a day of digging.

lines.zh: 哎，我被撞得翻了个身。
lines.en: Oof, I got knocked right over onto my back.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我太矮，你看不见我。
lines.en: Sorry, I'm too short for you to see.

lines.zh: 我滚出去两格，才爬起来。
lines.en: I roll two blocks before I get up.

lines.zh: 你踩住我背上的叶子了。
lines.en: Your boot is on a leaf of my back.

lines.zh: 我抱着头，缩成一团等你走。
lines.en: I curl up and wait for you to pass.

lines.zh: 让让，我这边过不去。
lines.en: Move over, I can't get through here.

lines.zh: 我被撞歪了，根须也掉了。
lines.en: I'm knocked crooked and dropped my root.

lines.zh: 我吱了一声，你听见没有。
lines.en: I squeaked once; did you hear me?

lines.zh: 我们挤一挤，都能过去。
lines.en: If we squeeze, we can both get past.

lines.zh: 我贴着你腿边蹭过去。
lines.en: I brush past the side of your leg.

lines.zh: 你也挖洞？这底下我先到的。
lines.en: You dig too? I got under here first.

lines.zh: 我们分一颗蹦蹦吧。
lines.en: Let's split one bouncy between us.

lines.zh: 你嚼东西的声音真好听。
lines.en: The sound of you chewing is lovely.

lines.zh: 我把挖出的远古根推给你。
lines.en: I push the ancient root I dug toward you.

lines.zh: 你的叶子比我绿。
lines.en: Your leaves are greener than mine.

lines.zh: 一起挖，快一点。
lines.en: Dig together and it goes faster.

lines.zh: 你那边有果子掉下来吗？
lines.en: Has any fruit fallen on your side?

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，什么都不说。
lines.en: We sit side by side saying nothing.

lines.zh: 别抢我脚底下这块石头。
lines.en: Don't steal the stone under my feet.

lines.zh: 晚上你睡在哪个坑里？
lines.en: Which hole do you sleep in at night?

lines.zh: 我捡到一颗，还是软的。
lines.en: I found one, and it's still soft.

lines.zh: 这个圆圆的东西，能吃吗？
lines.en: This round thing, can I eat it?

lines.zh: 我把蹦蹦捧在两只爪子里。
lines.en: I cradle the bouncy in both of my claws.

lines.zh: 地上有根，我先收着。
lines.en: There's a root here; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 这截东西亮亮的，我不认得。
lines.en: This little piece shines and I don't know it.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，跑回自己的坑。
lines.en: I carry it back to my own hole.

lines.zh: 我藏了一颗，明天再吃。
lines.en: I hid one away to eat tomorrow.

lines.zh: 捡到好东西，我想给你看。
lines.en: I found something good and want to show you.

lines.zh: 它还在动，我按住了。
lines.en: It's still moving, so I pin it down.

lines.zh: 我两爪捧着果子，挪得很慢。
lines.en: Both claws full of fruit, I shuffle very slowly.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在跳。
lines.en: Something over there is hopping.

lines.zh: 我看见一颗蹦蹦滚下坡。
lines.en: I see a bouncy rolling down the slope.

lines.zh: 果壳裂开了，里面在动。
lines.en: The fruit shell split and something moves inside.

lines.zh: 味道是从那个方向来的。
lines.en: The smell is coming from that direction.

lines.zh: 我停住，耳朵先竖起来。
lines.en: I stop, and my ears rise first.

lines.zh: 有东西掉在树根后面。
lines.en: Something fell behind the tree roots.

lines.zh: 我盯住那一点动静。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on that little movement.

lines.zh: 它背对我蹲着，机会来了。
lines.en: It crouches with its back to me; my moment.

lines.zh: 我把肚皮贴地，一点点挪近。
lines.en: Belly to the soil, I edge closer bit by bit.

lines.zh: 这一颗，归我了。
lines.en: This bouncy belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 别跳了，我追不上。
lines.en: Stop hopping, I can't keep up.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，堵住退路。
lines.en: I circle it and cut off its retreat.

lines.zh: 它蹦向东，我就绕到东边。
lines.en: It hops east, so I circle around to the east.

lines.zh: 再近一步，就扑。
lines.en: One more step and I pounce.

lines.zh: 我屏住气，肚子都不动了。
lines.en: I hold my breath and my belly stills.

lines.zh: 它停下来了，我也停下。
lines.en: It stops moving, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我盯得眼眶发酸，也不移开。
lines.en: My eyes ache from watching, but I don't look away.

lines.zh: 这块石头挡着我，我绕开。
lines.en: This stone blocks me, so I go around.

lines.zh: 快到了，快到了。
lines.en: Almost there, almost there.

lines.zh: 两只小爪子已经举起来了。
lines.en: Both of my little claws are raised now.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，牙很钝。
lines.en: I bite once, with my dull little teeth.

lines.zh: 我用头撞它，自己先晕。
lines.en: I headbutt it and daze myself first.

lines.zh: 爪子拍下去，只拍起土。
lines.en: My claws swing and only throw up dirt.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，真的。
lines.en: I am really not good at fighting.

lines.zh: 我把它按在地上，用体重。
lines.en: I pin it down using my whole weight.

lines.zh: 一根根须抽出去，缠住了。
lines.en: A root whips out and wraps around it.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，虽然没什么力气。
lines.en: I hold on with what little strength I have.

lines.zh: 它个头比我大，我还是冲上去。
lines.en: It's bigger than me, and I still charge.

lines.zh: 我踢了一脚，退了两步。
lines.en: I kick once and stumble back two steps.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你先动的。
lines.en: Don't blame me; you moved first.

lines.zh: 我从靛蓝石缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the indigo stone.

lines.zh: 第一口气，是果子的味道。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of fruit.

lines.zh: 林子很暗，但我不怕。
lines.en: The grove is dark, but I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 我把背上的碎土抖落。
lines.en: I shake the crumbled soil off my back.

lines.zh: 脚下是凉的石头，很舒服。
lines.en: The cool stone under me feels good.

lines.zh: 我睁眼就看见一颗果子。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see a fruit.

lines.zh: 这里以后就是我的地了。
lines.en: This place is mine from now on.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在嚼。
lines.en: I hear something chewing far away.

lines.zh: 我从根须之间挤了出来。
lines.en: I push out from between the roots.

lines.zh: 一开始我很小，只够一只手。
lines.en: At first I'm small enough for one hand.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖碰了碰地面。
lines.en: I touch the ground with my nose.

lines.zh: 果园的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I will remember the smell of this orchard.

lines.zh: 火太烫，我的叶子卷起来了。
lines.en: The fire's too hot; my leaves are curling.

lines.zh: 我从石台上滑下去，摔在根上。
lines.en: I slip off the ledge and land on a root.

lines.zh: 水淹过我的头，我不会游。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 一声响，我被掀进了土里。
lines.en: A blast throws me down into the soil.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的背，好深。
lines.en: Something jabs deep into my back.

lines.zh: 紫光裹住我，我的根在发抖。
lines.en: Violet light wraps me and my roots tremble.

lines.zh: 三天没蹦蹦了，我越来越轻。
lines.en: Three days without bouncies and I feel lighter.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，整片林子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole grove lights up.

lines.zh: 我掉出石头边缘，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: I slip off the stone edge into nothing.
